title: Performance under pressure
learning_outcomes: Explain pressure and attention in the context of performance under pressure.
Compare and distinguish low-stakes rehearsal in the context of performance under pressure.
Apply process and outcomes in the context of performance under pressure.
Evaluate and justify decisions about debrief in the context of performance under pressure.

lessons.title: Pressure and attention
lessons.outcome: Explain pressure and attention in the context of performance under pressure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving pressure and attention; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to presentation rehearsal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain pressure and attention from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of pressure and attention; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Low-stakes rehearsal
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish low-stakes rehearsal in the context of performance under pressure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving low-stakes rehearsal; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to presentation rehearsal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain low-stakes rehearsal from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of low-stakes rehearsal; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Process and outcomes
lessons.outcome: Apply process and outcomes in the context of performance under pressure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving process and outcomes; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to presentation rehearsal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain process and outcomes from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of process and outcomes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Debrief
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about debrief in the context of performance under pressure.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving debrief; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to presentation rehearsal.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain debrief from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of debrief; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of pressure and attention; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of low-stakes rehearsal; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of process and outcomes; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of debrief; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
